summaryEn: Elon Musk's company-wide update to SpaceX employees, published August 11, 2026: the story from the El Segundo warehouse to nearly 11,000 Starlink satellites and a 700th Falcon flight, then the road ahead — Starship, Starshield, and above all AI, whose revenue he says will exceed all other SpaceX revenue within weeks.
summaryZh: 埃隆·马斯克面向 SpaceX 全体员工的公司动态说明，发布于 2026 年 8 月 11 日：讲述了从埃尔塞贡多的仓库到近 11,000 颗星链卫星和猎鹰火箭第 700 次飞行的历程，随后谈及前路——星舰、星盾，以及最重要的人工智能；他说，其收入将在数周内超过 SpaceX 的所有其他收入。

segments.textEn: In order to understand the nature of the universe and all these fundamental questions, we must expand the scope and scale of consciousness. So it's been a while since the last company talk and I'll try to do these now every three months after our earnings calls, which is when I'm allowed to talk about things essentially at this point. So we're going to start off just by going through the history of SpaceX from the beginning and, and then to present day. I think once in a while it's good to look at the whole story and then think about what do you want the next chapters to be in the story? What do you want the next book to be in the story?

segments.textZh: 所以，我们一开始就有一个明确的使命，那就是让生命跨行星生存，将意识扩展到地球之外，去理解宇宙。而只有当你真正走出去，去探索、去观察其他行星，并最终观察其他恒星系统时，你才能理解宇宙。我认为，一个人所能想象的最鼓舞人心的事情之一、所能想象的最鼓舞人心的未来之一，就是我们置身群星之间，或许会遇见外星文明，或者探索那些延续了 100 万年、却在 1,000 万年前灭绝的文明遗迹。
